thread:
leo: PM wants a dashboard alerting on unit-econ drift per-model and a lightweight sandbox to preview routing changes impact (cost + cache savings) before rollouts. Is this doable without exploding telemetry?
karin: doable if we keep the inputs to model+route aggregates. emitter schema: minute rollups with tokens, cache_hits, seq_len_bucket_fracs, p50/p95. 5 buckets max.
ross: agree. big ask is 'drift' calc: compare predicted cost (from last MV used in simulator) vs observed burn next window. store daily sim_error per model. if median_error > 20% trigger alert.
mia: API idea: POST /api/internal/simulate/preview with body {model,route,policy_delta,lookback_mins}. returns {pred_cost_delta, pred_cache_savings, ci, top_contributors}. UI shows quick explain.
ux-ari: UX: inline mini-sandbox on model page with small controls: percent reroute, toggle prefetch, seq_len override. also an "Apply to canary" shortcut that pre-fills rollout percent and evaluation window. show uncertainty band and a tiny sparkline of past sim_error.
karin: implementation notes: MV recompute every 5m. store only model+route+env to limit cardinality. tenant-level previews should sample or use tenant_approx overrides.
leo: security: gate preview to beta admins; redact exact token counts for other orgs.
ops-bot: created ticket UE-9123 assigned to karin/ross. CI job 7789 queued. :gear:
mia: monitoring: emit sim_requests_total, sim_latency_ms, sim_error_percentile. daily job aggregates drift and surfaces top-5 models by error.
ross: performance: MVP can compute on-demand from last-10m MV; full feature with MV history and validation dashboard in 6-8 weeks.
leo: thanks team, I'll add PM acceptance criteria and share beta org list. please post proto and sample payload by EOD. :thumbsup:
